blurb:
Discover the hidden currents of Virginia Beach. Beyond the sun-drenched sand and bustling boardwalk lies a dramatic tale of transformation. Join us as we trace the city's evolution from a deadly maritime graveyard to a booming military stronghold, and finally, to a glittering luxury resort. This immersive audio journey reveals the secrets behind the monuments, the tragedies beneath the waves, and the fascinating duality of a city built on both danger and leisure.

A 2.4 km self-guided tour with 6 stops over 90 min
Ideal for travelers interested in History & Memory and Art, Design & Aesthetics
Immersively told in a podcast style by experts and locals
Matching audio content, AI guide and navigation through the app
